text.font-family: ManualKit Times, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Times New Roman, serif
ManualKit Times, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Times New Roman, serif

svg.text: O

text.font-family: ManualKit Times, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Times New Roman, serif

svg.text: ther forms of advertising come in a wide

text.font-family: ManualKit Times, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Times New Roman, serif

svg.text: variety of sizes and shapes. Out-of-home

text.font-family: ManualKit Times, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Times New Roman, serif

svg.text: media include such things as billboards and

text.font-family: ManualKit Times, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Times New Roman, serif

svg.text: transit advertising. Specialty items can cover

text.font-family: ManualKit Times, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Times New Roman, serif

svg.text: anything from bumper stickers to zeppelins.

text.font-family: ManualKit Times, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Times New Roman, serif

svg.text: Standards for out-of-home media depend on

text.font-family: ManualKit Times, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Times New Roman, serif

svg.text: the type of lighting used. For front-lit media,

text.font-family: ManualKit Times, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Times New Roman, serif

svg.text: the standards at the front of the manual apply.

text.font-family: ManualKit Times, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Times New Roman, serif

svg.text: For back-lit media, the guidelines are the

text.font-family: ManualKit Times, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Times New Roman, serif

svg.text: same as those for audio-visual, set out on page

text.font-family: ManualKit Times, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Times New Roman, serif

svg.text: 34. As with other forms of advertising, the

text.font-family: ManualKit Times, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Times New Roman, serif

svg.text: signature appears as the final element

text.font-family: ManualKit Times, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Times New Roman, serif

svg.text: Specialty items pose a need for careful quality

text.font-family: ManualKit Times, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Times New Roman, serif

svg.text: control where they have restricted space,

text.font-family: ManualKit Times, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Times New Roman, serif

svg.text: irregular contours or coarse textures. Often

text.font-family: ManualKit Times, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Times New Roman, serif

svg.text: these items were not designed for imprinting,

text.font-family: ManualKit Times, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Times New Roman, serif

svg.text: and results are unacceptable. Items which are

text.font-family: ManualKit Times, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Times New Roman, serif

svg.text: judged suitable must meet the signature and

text.font-family: ManualKit Times, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Times New Roman, serif

svg.text: typeface standards in the first section of

text.font-family: ManualKit Times, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Times New Roman, serif

svg.text: this manual.
